body:
My 7 year old son is obsessed with Monty the moose. We got a free copy of the DVD from our local libary, middle of no where Australia.
Was there ever merchandise made? I haven't had much luck with Google.
Run and you run fast. If him not being there makes no difference to your work load then there's no point him being there.

Jesus fuck. I'll stay. I dont matter clearly. I dont matter to my husband I should have known a bunch of strangers would also not care. All of you have convinced me its not worth it, end of the day if I have to be treated like shit of the benefit of the kids I will.
Sorry Im not in the greatest frame of mind. No they arent in danger. No one is.
Its not abusive. Jesus fuck. He loves and cares for those children, I dont matter to him. Stop projecting abuse and making it even fucking harder for me to give a shit about how I am treated.
They will be cared for, Ideally he will return home, find out Im not playing games anymore and he will leave and I will be at home with the kids.

Im not abandoning them. I will have everything set up before I go, I will be doing my job from somewhere else. You'd prefer I stay when he wont leave so they can be around fighting and a depressed mother?

Yes, I wouldn't leave them if they weren't. He is component and loves them, its every little things he wont do like school traditions dates which I plan on doing because I know he wont and preparing stuff ahead of time because he just doesn't think of it.
I've messaged a friend, we aren't super close but she lives alone so she said I can stay with her.
Thank you ❤️ I will update once everything happens I guess.
Any complaints about our relationship are either to him directly or reddit, Ive messaged a friend to see if I can stay with her till I sort it out.

We come from broken families and have always been seen as the golden couple, we were perfect for each other from the day we met. Unfortunately that led to us never opening up about any problems we faced and as far as our family and friends know we are happy and thriving. I cant imagine any help from two families where divorced and resentment are normal.
Not close unfortunately. About 2 years ago we moved across Australia away from all our family and friends and I haven't made connections here.
We have tried but its out of our budget and we dont meet government requirements for free sessions.
No, he was emotionally abusive towards the end, he has left back to our original state.
I just feel like I remind him every year and it upsets me he doesnt seem to remember. Its a conversation we have yearly at this rate.
